title_cyr: Питат ме, мамо, в село момите
title_latin: Pitat me, mamo, v selo momite
title_en: The girls in the village are asking me, mother

lines.cyr: Питат ме, мамо, в село момите:
lines.lat: Pitat me, mamo, v selo momite:
lines.en: The girls in the village are asking me, mother:

lines.cyr: - Што ти се, Гано, црни очите?
lines.lat: - Što ti se, Gano, crni očite?
lines.en: - Why are your eyes so black, Gana?

lines.cyr: А јас им думам, думам, продумам:
lines.lat: A jas im dumam, dumam, produmam:
lines.en: And I tell them, I tell them:
- When my mother gave birth to me,
she held black cherries in her hands.

lines.cyr: Питат ме, мамо, в село момите:
lines.lat: Pitat me, mamo, v selo momite:
lines.en: The girls in the village are asking me, mother:

lines.cyr: - Што ти е, Гано, тенка снагата?
lines.lat: - Što ti e, Gano, tenka snagata?
lines.en: - Why is your body so slim, Gana?

lines.cyr: А јас им думам, думам, продумам:
lines.lat: A jas im dumam, dumam, produmam:
lines.en: And I tell them, I tell them:
- When my mother gave birth to me,
she held young twigs in her hands.

lines.cyr: Питат ме, мамо, в село момите
lines.lat: Pitat me, mamo, v selo momite
lines.en: The girls in the village are asking me, mother:

lines.cyr: - Што ти е, Гано, бело лицето?
lines.lat: - Što ti e, Gano, belo liceto?
lines.en: - Why is your face so white, Gana?

lines.cyr: А јас им думам, думам, продумам:
lines.lat: A jas im dumam, dumam, produmam:
lines.en: And I tell them, I tell them:
- When my mother gave birth to me,

lines.cyr: с' пресно си млеко лице умила!
lines.lat: s' presno si mleko lice umila!
lines.en: she washed her face with fresh milk!
